searchText: <@!273808422753796097> why was single slot finality not chosen in the beginning of the beacon chain? what has changed to make this better and more apt now (near future)? (in an ELI5 way) https://ethresear.ch/t/a-model-for-cumulative-committee-based-finality/10259 maybe not ELI5 lol Also take a listen to his EDCON talk on this: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nPgUKNPWXNI iirc graceful fallback when less than 2/3rds is online (i.e. fork choice) was one those reasons. Things that have changed are for example the shortcomings of LMD-GHOST i listened to the talk and that's why i'm hoping for a more ELI5, as in what has changed between then and now and why didn't we start with single slot finality right away
